notes.source: Shot model metrics from Understat (not Opta / FPL expected_goals).
notes.sot: On target = Goal + SavedShot + ShotOnPost. Blocked shots are excluded.
notes.cc: Chances created = shot preceded by this player as player_assisted (passer before the shot).
notes.per90_team: Team per-90 uses finished matches (metric ÷ matches).
notes.per90_player: Player per-90 uses Understat season minutes when available.
notes.display: Team header shows metric plus S (shots) and SoT (on target).
notes.views: Treemap = players in team. Matrices = situation / last-action creation and defensive concede.

last_action_groups.definition: The shot followed a short or constructed pass (including lay-offs and headed passes). Reads as patterned build-up rather than a chaos or wide delivery.
The chance was created by a pass that split the line and found a runner in space.
The preceding action was a cross or chipped delivery, typically from wide areas into the box.
The shooter (or carrier) created the chance by beating a defender or a skill/touch that opened the shot.
The shot came after winning the ball — recovery, interception, tackle, challenge, or forcing a dispossess.
The shot came from a chaotic second phase the attacker did not cleanly design: rebounds, aerials, clearances, blocked passes, or goalkeeper saves/punches that dropped to a shooter.
No useful preceding action was recorded, or the label is administrative noise (e.g. none, foul, substitution) rather than how the chance was built.
